description: The act table cites, for the dialog, a spec that never names the control the act presses. The table owes its gestures to the specs — the key that opens a menu has one home and the table points there (0017) — and a citation that points at a file which never touches the control is prose dressed as a link. The defect is built here: the owner of `/dialog` is rewritten to the axe sweep, a tracked spec that presses nothing. It was live for twelve days before this case existed: two of nine acts named a control their cited spec had never pressed.
